warmup_welcome: Welcome! Thanks so much for playing our game! You’re going to watch some short stories about different people and answer a few questions about what happened. For some of the questions, you’ll show us what you think by moving cookies around the screen. Before the stories begin, let’s practice moving the cookies!
cookie_explanation: In our game, you can move cookies wherever you like. If you move cookies to another person, that person gets to keep them. If you move cookies to the cookie jar, nobody gets them.
cookie_identify_michael: This is Michael. He has three cookies.
cookie_explanation_opening: In our game, you can move cookies wherever you like.
cookie_explanation_person: If you move cookies to another person, that person gets to keep them.
cookie_explanation_jar: If you move cookies to the cookie jar, nobody gets them.
cookie_practice_jar: Let’s try! Move some of Michael’s cookies to the cookie jar.
cookie_practice_person: Now move some of Michael’s cookies to Claire.
fault_explanation_first: In our game, you’ll be asked how much each person is at fault. If you think someone is a lot at fault, make a lot of their bar blue. If you think they are a little at fault, make a small part of their bar blue. If you think they are not at fault, click the little part at the beginning of their bar.
fault_explanation_intro: In our game, you’ll be asked how much each person is at fault.
fault_explanation_large: If you think someone is a lot at fault, make a lot of their bar blue.
fault_explanation_small: If you think they are a little at fault, make a small part of their bar blue.
fault_explanation_zero: If you think they are not at fault, click the little part at the beginning of their bar.
fault_practice_large: Show that Michael is a lot at fault and Claire is not at fault.
fault_practice_large_reversed: Show that Claire is not at fault and Michael is a lot at fault.
fault_practice_small: Show that Claire is a little at fault and Michael is not at fault.
fault_practice_small_reversed: Show that Michael is not at fault and Claire is a little at fault.
carelessness_explanation_second: You’ll also use the same bars to show how careless each person was. A bigger bar means more careless.
carelessness_explanation_first: In our game, you’ll be asked how careless each person was. If you think someone was very careless, make a lot of their bar blue. If you think they were a little careless, make a small part of their bar blue. If you think they were not careless, click the little part at the beginning of their bar.
carelessness_explanation_intro: In our game, you’ll be asked how careless each person was.
carelessness_explanation_large: If you think someone was very careless, make a lot of their bar blue.
carelessness_explanation_small: If you think they were a little careless, make a small part of their bar blue.
carelessness_explanation_zero: If you think they were not careless, click the little part at the beginning of their bar.
carelessness_practice_large: Show that Michael was very careless and Claire was not careless.
carelessness_practice_large_reversed: Show that Claire was not careless and Michael was very careless.
carelessness_practice_small: Show that Claire was a little careless and Michael was not careless.
carelessness_practice_small_reversed: Show that Michael was not careless and Claire was a little careless.
fault_explanation_second: You’ll also use the same bars to show how much each person is at fault. A bigger bar means more at fault.
ready: Thank you! Now let’s see the stories.
